lifecycle, incorporating product changes, field learnings and reliability findings.</li> <li>Define validation strategies, acceptance criteria and qualification approaches for new devices and significant changes.</li> <li>Define what evidence should be produced by hardware partners and external laboratories, and review test plans, results and technical evidence for completeness and quality.</li> <li>Challenge gaps in supplier validation, technical claims, RCA and corrective actions, and ensure additional evidence or actions are provided where needed.</li> <li>Support technical assessment and qualification of new devices, suppliers and future RFPs.</li> <li>Assess the technical impact of lifecycle changes and ensure field failures, RCA and corrective actions feed back into
